name: NieR Automata
format: Per-slot binary saves contain a binding block in a documented older implementation; global SystemData is separate
limitations: A published save-tool implementation locates a binding block in SlotData. Its old offsets/lengths are evidence of storage, not authorization to patch a current save at assumed offsets.
Current slot layout, key-code representation and integrity checks must be verified. Steam/account identity and progression must remain untouched.
V3 explicitly defers Fire, Light Attack and Heavy Attack for mouse-ownership checking. Those are not missing placements to invent.
